drug_class: 5-Alpha Reductase Inhibitor combined with Alpha-1 Blocker
purpose: This medication is used to treat the symptoms of an enlarged prostate, a condition called benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). It helps reduce the size of the prostate over time and also relaxes the muscles around the prostate and bladder to make urination easier. This combination helps you urinate more freely and reduces bothersome symptoms like frequent urination, weak stream, or feeling like your bladder never fully empties.
how_it_works: This medication is actually two medicines working together. Dutasteride lowers the hormone that causes your prostate to grow, which helps shrink it over time — though this can take several months to notice. Tamsulosin relaxes the muscles in your prostate and the opening of your bladder, which gives you faster relief from urinary symptoms while the dutasteride works on shrinking the prostate.
common_side_effects: Some common side effects include decreased sex drive, difficulty getting or keeping an erection, decreased amount of semen during ejaculation, dizziness (especially when standing up quickly), runny or stuffy nose, and breast tenderness or swelling. Most of these are manageable and may improve over time.
warnings: Women who are pregnant or could become pregnant should never touch this medication, as it can cause serious birth defects in male babies. You should not donate blood while taking this medication or for at least 6 months after stopping it. This drug can affect your PSA levels, a test used to screen for prostate cancer, so always tell your doctor you are taking it. Talk to your doctor right away if you notice breast lumps, pain, or nipple discharge, as there is a small increased risk of a serious type of breast cancer. Avoid driving or doing anything risky until you know how this medication affects you, since it can cause dizziness.
typical_dosing: The usual dose is one capsule taken by mouth once a day, about 30 minutes after the same meal each day. Swallow it whole — do not crush, chew, or open the capsule. Try to take it at the same time every day to keep it working consistently.
